conventions.coordinates: RAS mm; arrays indexed [k, j, i]; affine maps (i, j, k, 1) -> RAS
conventions.sheets: wall = the tile's tissue face draped onto the gtcore cavity wall the way the conformer drapes it (flat offsets from the anchor cast along the anchor normal); seed = +3 mm, cavity = +4 mm along the local inward normal; row-major n x n, faces shared (sheet_faces)
conventions.modes: opt_rind5_* / opt_ctvgt_* = the optimizer's best SA seed per objective family; count<N>_* = count-known N full fit (pipeline chord path); count_<F>full_<H>half_* = planner prior fit; seed_tile_id -1 = leftover

opt_rind5.objective_target: optimizer default: +5 mm shell of the eligible wall, area weights (S5 surrogate of RIND5)
opt_rind5.best_rule: highest RIND5(gtcore cavity, clip cranial interior) V100 over the SA seeds

opt_ctvgt.objective_target: HRCTV_PHYS: CTV_GT voxel centres from the RTSTRUCT (70438 points, unit weights = volume weights on the CT grid; M_opt 4000 subsample)
opt_ctvgt.best_rule: highest HRCTV_PHYS (CTV_GT) V100 over the SA seeds

eligible.rule: union of (a) candidates.craniotomy_faces(mesh, opening, implant_center_ras=None) and (b) wall faces whose centroid lies within 10 mm of an implanted seed centre (demonstrated reach; coordinator 2026-11-03)

as_implanted.label: as implanted: 32 localized seeds, physical (PCA) axes
as_implanted.note: the dose of the implant as found; independent of the tile fit
